chapter: After the Paradise: club dates and Virginia
title: The Florida job going sour after eight weeks
summary: The Sir John Hotel job, 16 weeks planned, ended after eight when Timmy refused to leave the stage on time for the Trenier Twins.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What caused it to go down the drain again?
Well, I mean we wouldn't be in there much longer, you know what I mean, eight weeks, you know, we were supposed to be in there 16 weeks.
Yeah. But what caused it to go down the drain?
Oh. Timmy didn't cooperate with the management about stayin' on stage too long, you see.
